title: Normalization after field extension compares by a universal homeomorphism
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $X$ an integral scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $K/k$ be any field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and write $X_K=X	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $
u:X^
u	o X$ be its function-field normalization [def-sc-normalization], and let $
u_K:Y	o X_K$ be the componentwise normalization of the reduction of $X_K$ [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. There is a canonical morphism $b:Y	o X^
u	imes_k K$ over $X_K$, induced by the normalization maps. It is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].

source.place: Tag 0C3N, label lemma-normalization-and-change-of-fields, universal-homeomorphism assertion for arbitrary field extensions, specialized to integral finite-type X.
